description: This file implements an Attribute-Based Access Control (ABAC) authorizer for Kubernetes, including policy loading, matching, and authorization logic.

classes.name: policyLoadError
classes.description: Custom error type for errors encountered while loading policies from files.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns a formatted error message for policy load errors.

methods.name: NewFromFile
methods.description: Loads a list of ABAC policies from a specified file.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Determines if a policy matches a given set of authorization attributes.

methods.name: subjectMatches
methods.description: Checks if a user and group match the policy's subject criteria.

methods.name: verbMatches
methods.description: Checks if the request verb matches the policy's read-only setting.

methods.name: nonResourceMatches
methods.description: Checks if a non-resource request matches the policy.

methods.name: resourceMatches
methods.description: Checks if a resource request matches the policy.

methods.name: Authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a request based on the loaded policies.

methods.name: RulesFor
methods.description: Returns resource and non-resource rules applicable to a user in a namespace.

methods.name: getVerbs
methods.description: Returns allowed verbs based on whether the policy is read-only.
